    direction LR

    class OwnerRepository {
        <<interface>>
        +findByLastNameStartingWith(String lastName, Pageable pageable) Page~Owner~

    }

        <<interface>>
        +save(S entity) S
        +saveAndFlush(S entity) S

    class Owner {
        -String address

        -List~Pet~ pets
    }

        -OwnerRepository owners
        +OwnerController(OwnerRepository owners)
        +findOwner(Integer ownerId) Owner
        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
        +processFindForm(int page, Owner owner, BindingResult result, Model model) String
        -findPaginatedForOwnersLastName(int page, String lastname) Page~Owner~
        +processUpdateOwnerForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, int ownerId, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
        +showOwner(int ownerId) ModelAndView
    }

    class PetController {
        -OwnerRepository owners
        -PetTypeRepository types
        +PetController(OwnerRepository owners, PetTypeRepository types)
        +findOwner(int ownerId) Owner
        +findPet(int ownerId, Integer petId) Pet
        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
        +processUpdateForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
    }

    class VisitController {
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +VisitController(OwnerRepository owners)
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit
        +processNewVisitForm(Owner owner, int petId, Visit visit, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String

    OwnerRepository ..> Optional : returns

    OwnerController --> OwnerRepository : owners
    PetController --> OwnerRepository : owners
    VisitController --> OwnerRepository : owners
```
